title: All expressions (quick · looping)
text: Every kept expression, including moving tears and silly cross-eyed. Silent, loops until any control takes over.

title: Sample 1 (redone)
text: Hey Drue! 😂 That story was wild. 😮 Are you serious? 🙂 Talk soon.

title: You won't believe this
text: Okay Drue, you're not going to believe this [disbelief] but the whole thing actually works on your phone. [smile] Pretty cool, right?

title: Joke, then the laugh
text: Why did the robot go on vacation? It needed to recharge its batteries. [laugh] Okay, okay. [skeptical] That one was a little rough.

title: Mood tour
text: [think] Hmm, let me think about that for a second. [worried] I was a little worried it might not work. [relieved] But it did! [excited] [proud] And honestly, I'm kind of proud of it.

title: Cue inside a word
text: That is unbeliev[disbelief]able, Drue. It works on the phone. [smile] Ha[laugh]ha, okay.

title: Lips: P/B/M, F/V, OO
text: Please bring my big blue boots. Five fine violins of velvet. Who knew? Two cool shoes. Shh, she should think, though.

title: Sad, then better
text: I have to tell you something. [sad] The old sample got taken down. [smile] But the new one is even better, look!

title: Sample 2 (redone)
text: Hi Drue, this is Aloy. 🤩 I finally have a voice and a face that moves with it! 😂 Honestly, it took the whole crew to get here. 😮 Can you believe it works on your phone? 🙂 Tap replay any time. Talk soon.

title: Thinking to herself (silent)
text: No talking, no audio: she drifts through mild moods on her own, glancing at her phone. Runs until you tap Stop. (v3.2: no tears, no flash peaks.)

title: Rapid Cycle (silent)
text: 13 mild moods, about 1.2 s each with smooth blends, 25 s, then back to her smile. No sound.

title: Full Tour (silent)
text: Every kept expression, about 2.8 s each, 48 s, then back to her smile. No sound.

title: Happy
source: proud brows/eyes patch at 75% over her own amused smile (patch-proud.webp on amused.jpg); the smile fits, no teeth grin
text: Happy: eases in, holds 16 s with blinks and breathing, eases back to her smile. No sound.

title: Sad
source: full sad.jpg with its own sad mouth, eased in through amused-sadtop.jpg; no tears
text: Sad: eases in, holds 16 s with blinks and breathing, eases back to her smile. No sound.

title: Angry (mild)
source: no mild angry face exists: full determined.jpg (firm brows, closed mouth)
text: Angry (mild): eases in, holds 16 s with blinks and breathing, eases back to her smile. No sound.

title: Focused
text: Focused: eases in, holds 16 s with blinks and breathing, eases back to her smile. No sound.

title: Worried
text: Worried: eases in, holds 16 s with blinks and breathing, eases back to her smile. No sound.

title: Flirty (mild)
source: TweakX flirty-halflid (+ -closed for blinks), blush-overlay.png composited at build (halflid-blush, wink-left-blush + their -closed), one wink; glance-left/right-soft and coy-smirk left out
text: Half-lidded, a blush fades in, one wink, then eases back to her smile. No sound.
